name: Chief Ray Studio
tagline: Photography and video by Sam, based in British Columbia.
description: Street, portrait, landscape and commercial photography and video by Sam, based in British Columbia.
about: I'm Sam, a photographer and videographer based in British Columbia. I shoot street photos downtown, portraits and landscapes, and I work with local businesses on photos and short videos they can actually use.
If you need listing photos, menu shots or a promo reel, send me a message with what you have in mind and when you need it.

contact_form.booking_note: Booking a few shoots at a portfolio rate this season.

faq.a: Every shoot is quoted on what you need: time on location, how many edited photos, and whether you want video. Send a message and I'll reply with a quote.
Anywhere in the Lower Mainland. Further out is fine too; travel may be added to the quote.

faq.q: How fast will I get my photos?
faq.a: Usually within a week of the shoot. If you need them sooner, ask and I'll tell you what's possible.

faq.q: How many photos will I get?
faq.a: It depends on the shoot, and your quote spells it out. Every photo you get is fully edited.

faq.q: Can I use the photos for my business?
faq.a: Yes: on your website, social media, menus and listings. For print ads or anything else, mention it in your message.
Yes. Short promo videos, reels and property walkthroughs.
